newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: POSCO sees 878.7 bln won net profit '97.
newsitem.headline: POSCO sees 878.7 bln won net profit '97.

text.p: South Korea's largest steelmaker Pohang Iron and Steel Co is forecast to post 878.7 billion won in net profit in calendar 1997 versus 623.96 billion last year, a company official said on Wednesday.
The official told Reuters POSCO would post 9.08 trillion won in turnover this year from 8.45 trillion won last year.
"We expect the steel industry will recover from the second half of this year aided by increasing overseas demand," he said.
Sales of high-value added stainless steel would rise thanks to increasing production capacity last year.
The company expected crude steel production to reach 26.5 million tonnes in 1997, up 2.2 million tonnes from 1996.
